Subject: ACME - Q3 commit verification & SKU cleanup

Claire — thanks again for the call this morning. To keep our mutual forecast clean for Q3 close, we need a short transactional cleanup so our finance and RevOps teams can certify ARR and SKUs. Can you confirm the attached CSV maps to the three line items you expect to sign this quarter? Quick asks: 1) Confirm the exact product SKUs (redwood-pro-1, redwood-pro-2) and per-unit ARR in column B; 2) Mark any deals where procurement requires a PO or signature (procurement column); 3) Confirm expected close date (column D).

I attached a short checklist (Q3-commit-checklist.xlsx) with the normalization steps our RevOps team will perform once you confirm. If you can reply by EOD Wed 7/17 we can lock the HubSpot records and produce a final pricing PDF for signatures.

Attachments: acme_deal_lines.csv; Q3-commit-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan

Thanks Claire and Ben — appreciate the fast turnaround. Two clarifications before we lock the records: 1) Claire, when you mark the contingent line at 40% in your reply, can you also add a one-line reason (example: "awaiting compliance data-transfer addendum") so RevOps has audit text; 2) Ben, when you canonicalize SKUs please also push a note to the HS record describing the mapping (old->new) so our finance team can trace any ARR discrepancy during close.

If procurement sends the DocuSign link, we will sign once legal confirms the T&Cs. Lauren / Marissa — fyi on the compliance hold. If compliance extends beyond 7/31 we should consider changing expected close to Aug quarter review.

Priya
